Diagnosis.submission: The home-timeline-service is failing to retrieve followers from the social-graph-service when processing WriteHomeTimeline requests from the compose-post-service. This causes the compose-post flow to fail with a "ZADD: no key specified" Redis error. The social-graph-service GetFollowers call from the home-timeline-service is failing, preventing the home timeline from being written for followers. This breaks the entire post composition flow since compose-post depends on successfully writing to home timelines.
